title: Skills
subtitle: Leadership first, with the technical depth to back it up

agenticShift.title: Leading the shift to agentic development
agenticShift.paragraph1: Since 2025 my teams have worked with AI coding agents as part of everyday development, from writing code to automated testing. I ran workshops to help everyone get the most out of agentic workflows, and it shows: we now open two to three times as many pull requests, and QA went from almost no test automation to covering more than half of our testing.
agenticShift.paragraph2: As agents take on more of the writing, the bottlenecks move to planning, review and testing, so that is what I focus on. The important part is that people stay in charge of the decisions, and the team still understands and owns everything it ships.
